programs.note: General-fund spending of the county's 42 school districts and the County Office of Education, 2023-24 actuals, spread over ages 4-18 by population (includes transitional kindergarten; a little adult education is not separated). Independent charter schools, cafeteria funds and bond-funded construction are not in this figure

programs.program: Child welfare, foster care and adoptions
programs.note: Child and Family Well-Being department, all placed at ages 0-17 by population. Extended foster care to age 21 and services to parents are not separated

Spread like statewide recipients in six age groups (January 2024), assuming equal hours per person; recipients by age are not published for the county. Most of what caregivers are paid is state and federal money that does not pass through the county budget
Spread over ages 60 and over by population. Adult protective services also serve dependent adults under 60, who are not separated

programs.program: Cash aid and related services (mostly CalWORKs)
programs.note: Spread by children and adults in San Diego County CalWORKs cash-grant cases (2023-24), assuming equal dollars per person; children over ages 0-17 and adults over 18-49 by population. The line also holds general relief for adults and contracted employment services, which are not separated

Staff who enrol people in benefits, spread like San Diego County's Medi-Cal eligibles in four age groups (July 2024 to June 2025), then by population. The benefits themselves are state and federal spending and are not in the county budget

Spread like the county's unique mental health clients by age in 2024-25 (children's and adult systems), assuming equal cost per client, then by population within each age group. Cost per client is not published by age

programs.program: County psychiatric hospital and Edgemoor nursing facility
programs.note: Two adult facilities, spread like clients of the adult mental health system by age in 2024-25, then by population. Edgemoor's residents are probably older than that mix. Billing to Medi-Cal, Medicare and other insurers counts as local money here
Spread like the county's unique substance-use clients by age in 2024-25, assuming equal cost per client, then by population within each age group
Medical care for children with serious conditions, spread over ages 0-20 by population

Spread evenly across county residents: no figures by age. County branches and parks mostly serve the unincorporated area and smaller cities, so a City of San Diego resident receives less than this average
Spread evenly across City of San Diego residents: no figures by age. Shown per city resident; funding sources are not separated in the city's data
Spread evenly across City of San Diego residents: no figures by age. Shown per city resident; funding sources are not separated in the city's data
